Training Details

Scientific Poultry Farming & Business Training

Practical learning covering poultry science, farm management, business planning, documentation and financing.

DAY 1

Scientific Poultry Farming

  • Farm setup, brooding and feeding
  • Disease prevention and vaccination
  • Biosecurity and bird management
  • Production optimization
DAY 2

Management & Business Model

  • Costing, record keeping and production planning
  • Marketing and sales strategies
  • Profitability analysis
  • Scaling and expansion
DAY 3

Business Setup, Documentation & Finance

  • Business registration and documents
  • DPR preparation
  • Investment and working capital
  • Bank loan process and repayment planning
